name: The menu explains why flight-controller tiles are closed when the link is down
step: Check that the menu explains why flight-controller tiles are closed when the link is down
rationale:
A menu tile that needs the flight controller is closed while the link is down. While the background task is running, disabled tiles on Ethos receive no touch events, so the menu raises the notice from its own state after a grace period. A pilot whose flight controller does not answer was previously left with disabled tiles and no feedback (#2319).

lib/menu_feedback.lua decides whether a tile is closed by the link. The harness checks this decision against the open rule in all combinations. It also verifies that the menu state raises the notice after the grace period, that the tool latches it once per link loss and re-arms when telemetry returns, and that all locales contain the notice strings. --self-test replaces the decision with the old silent rule and requires the fix case to fail.
